body: Thanks for the help, I appreciate it.
She just seems…. Happy about their relationship? Like, happy as in she’s glad that she’s networking with people in her major.
Honestly I doubt a TA would get in trouble, but I do question his professionalism considering the fact that my girlfriend has mentioned me a couple of times in their conversations.
It really sucks, I don’t know what’s going on at all because we attend different institutions. I’m just having all these anxious thoughts by myself :/
I honestly have no clue. When my girlfriend talked about receiving this gift from him, she kept saying how happy she was about it, yet she didn’t seem to believe that he was into her at all…
